BL-1513 — route_backlog_to_coder.sh composes its Work note from the ticket file's basename and cuts it to the 80-char message limit, so 52 of 107 live tickets reach their first role with the instruction's tail gone (BL-1494 arrived as `read file in backlo` at 07:51Z on 2026-09-10, was completed unworked at 07:55Z and re-routed by hand at 08:21Z); the note names the ticket id and its path, fits for every id, and a message that cannot fit is refused whole, never sent cut
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the router composes its dispatch note from the ticket id and refuses, never cuts, a message over the 80-character limit; the parsers that read the note are untouched and notes already o…
